name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Shattered Backboard' 2025
story_html: The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Shattered Backboard' revives the popular 2015 colorway, inspired by the jersey that Michael Jordan wore during an exhibition game in Italy following his rookie NBA season. (He shattered the backboard while executing a one-handed dunk.) The high-top sports a leather upper that combines white quarter panels with a black forefoot overlay and matching black Swoosh while orange accents land on the toe box, heel, and collar flap.
